description: Look up a customer's Fold referral code and share link. Use this when the customer wants to share Fold with a friend or check how many people they've successfully referred. Returns the code, a ready-to-paste link (foldlaundry.com/r/CODE), and stats. Both sides get $25 in credit after the friend completes their first pickup.

email.description: Customer email used at Fold signup. Required.
